dialoguesToLoad.text: Are you two alright? What's he doing here?
It's a long story. Well, actually no, but no one cares anyway. What's up?
Everyone's safe. They're all here with me.
So, why did everyone but us disappear?
Actually, we were rescued from the Archadian army.
Cool, you know why they forgot the two of us?
You mean the three of us.
Zack, this is Joel. He is the leader of this village.
So you abracadbra a dozen people and then you just leave us here with the pluvials?
One of you smells of the Beast, and the other smells of blood. Oh, and the third is a Archadian general. You don't belong here.
It's OK. If they are not welcome, we'll leave.
Just give us some supplies, like you promised, and we'll be on our way.
Kira... As you wish. You can still stay the night, if you want to.
For Hero's sake, finally! Some time to nap!
